headline: Central Bank of Egypt and European Investment Bank Discuss Sustainable Finance
summary: Central Bank of Egypt Governor Hassan Abdalla met with European Investment Bank Vice-President Gelsomina Vigliotti to discuss future partnerships and sustainable finance cooperation.
why: The Central Bank of Egypt oversees monetary policy and international financial institutional cooperation for North Africa's largest economy.

impacts.name: Egypt
impacts.why: Closer cooperation with the EIB secures development funding and promotes sustainable infrastructure investment in Egypt.
